summary: Your own TV channels in Jellyfin's Live TV, made from your films and series, with your own branding.
does: Create your own TV channel makes channels in Jellyfin's Live TV from your series, films, collections, playlists, genres or decades. Each runs to a schedule like broadcast television, so choosing a channel joins it part way through whatever is on.

Between programmes it can show idents, trailers, promos, adverts, public service announcements, your own clips and Coming up next cards. A broadcast pack adds your own on-screen logo, music and transitions. A schedule grid lets you plan a week for each channel.
for: People who like the feel of a TV channel and want to set up their own, with their own branding. Setting up is made for a computer, not a phone or tablet.
needs: Jellyfin set up in Starboard. Setting up the channels, the schedule grid and the broadcast pack need a desktop browser. A broadcast pack is optional, and an example pack, Example TV, is offered.
shows: One dashboard card, What is on now, listing each channel on air with the programme, how far through it is, what is next and any viewers. Its tab has pages for Channels, Guide, Schedule grid, Idents and clips and Broadcast pack.
